lines.zh: 我一动，整片水都跟着晃。
lines.en: When I move, the whole stretch of water sways.

lines.zh: 我缓慢地推水，像推开一扇门。
lines.en: I push the water slowly, as if opening a door.

lines.zh: 我贴着海床走，影子盖住了礁石。
lines.en: I travel the seabed, and my shadow covers the reef.

lines.zh: 我的伞盖一张，鱼群被推开半米。
lines.en: My bell opens and pushes the school half a meter off.

lines.zh: 我绕过沉船，桅杆只到我伞边。
lines.en: I pass the wreck; its mast reaches only my bell's rim.

lines.zh: 我每前进一次，就发出一声闷响。
lines.en: Every surge of mine ends in a low thud.

lines.zh: 我在深沟上方漂，沟底看不见。
lines.en: I drift over the trench, whose floor is out of sight.

lines.zh: 我朝浅处挪，那里有我要的暖。
lines.en: I move for the shallows, where the warmth I want is.

lines.zh: 我的触须拖在身后很长很长。
lines.en: My tentacles trail a very long way behind me.

lines.zh: 我从一群水母中穿过，它们让开了。
lines.en: I pass through a crowd of jellies, and they part.

lines.zh: 我慢慢升，水压从伞面上退去。
lines.en: I rise slowly, and the pressure slides off my bell.

lines.zh: 我沿着断崖走，崖壁上全是旧痕。
lines.en: I follow the cliff, its face covered in old scars.

lines.zh: 我经过的地方，沙子很久才落定。
lines.en: Where I pass, the sand takes long to settle.

lines.zh: 我一次能漂很远，我不赶时间。
lines.en: One drift carries me far, and I am in no hurry.

lines.zh: 我缓缓下压，整片海床暗了一截。
lines.en: I sink slowly and a stretch of seabed goes dark.

lines.zh: 我顺着一道冷流漂出很远。
lines.en: I ride a cold current a long way out.

lines.zh: 我悬在深处，像一座沉没的钟。
lines.en: I hang in the deep like a sunken bell.

lines.zh: 我几乎不动，海流也推不动我。
lines.en: I barely move, and the current cannot push me either.

lines.zh: 我很大，可我大部分是水。
lines.en: I am huge, but most of me is water.

lines.zh: 我慢慢呼吸，周围的鱼都安静了。
lines.en: I breathe slowly, and the fish around me go quiet.

lines.zh: 我等了很多年，等成现在这样。
lines.en: I waited many years and became what I am.

lines.zh: 我体内的气沉在下面，像压舱石。
lines.en: The gas inside settles low like ballast stones.

lines.zh: 我的光只照亮自己的一小块。
lines.en: My glow lights only one small patch of me.

lines.zh: 我听海床的声音，它比海面慢。
lines.en: I listen to the seabed; it is slower than the surface.

lines.zh: 我在暗处待着，暗处让我安心。
lines.en: I keep to the dark, and the dark puts me at ease.

lines.zh: 我不需要觅食，水自己送上门。
lines.en: I do not hunt; the water delivers.

lines.zh: 我垂下触须，让它们各自飘着。
lines.en: I let my tentacles hang and drift on their own.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，礁石也不过如此。
lines.en: I stay still, and even the reef seems restless beside me.

lines.zh: 我等的那一下，总会来的。
lines.en: The moment I am waiting for will come eventually.

lines.zh: 我沉在这里，海把我当成地形。
lines.en: I lie here until the sea treats me as terrain.

lines.zh: 我低下头看你，你得抬头才看得见我。
lines.en: I lower my gaze; you must look up to see me.

lines.zh: 你在我面前，小得像一粒沙。
lines.en: You before me are as small as a grain of sand.

lines.zh: 我的伞盖遮住了你的光。
lines.en: My bell blots out your light.

lines.zh: 我看了你很久，才决定不动。
lines.en: I watch you a long time before deciding not to move.

lines.zh: 你的火把在我身上照出一块斑。
lines.en: Your torch throws one bright patch on my body.

lines.zh: 我认得你这种尺寸的猎物。
lines.en: I know prey of your size.

lines.zh: 你退了半步，我什么都没做。
lines.en: You step back, and I have done nothing.

lines.zh: 我的触须在你头顶慢慢垂下来。
lines.en: My tentacles lower slowly over your head.

lines.zh: 我打量你的船，它比我还小。
lines.en: I size up your boat; it is smaller than I am.

lines.zh: 我转得很慢，转过来就不再转回去。
lines.en: I turn slowly, and once turned I do not turn back.

lines.zh: 疼，可我大得不容易被打倒。
lines.en: It hurts, but I am too big to be felled easily.

lines.zh: 这一下在我身上只留一个印。
lines.en: That leaves one mark on me.

lines.zh: 我慢慢退开，退了很远。
lines.en: I withdraw slowly, and I withdraw far.

lines.zh: 我体内晃了一下，很快就平了。
lines.en: The gas inside sloshes once and settles.

lines.zh: 你打得很用力，我看得出来。
lines.en: You struck hard; I can tell.

lines.zh: 我垂下触须，不是示弱，是准备。
lines.en: I lower my tentacles, not in surrender but in preparation.

lines.zh: 我疼的时候会很安静。
lines.en: When I hurt, I go very quiet.

lines.zh: 我身上缺了一块，水灌进来。
lines.en: A piece of me is gone, and water pours in.

lines.zh: 我还可以挨很多下，你不行。
lines.en: I can take many more blows; you cannot.

lines.zh: 再打下去，我只能炸给你看。
lines.en: Keep hitting and my only answer is to burst.

lines.zh: 你撒的那点东西，塞牙都不够。
lines.en: What you scatter would not fill a tooth gap.

lines.zh: 可我居然还是朝你挪了。
lines.en: And yet I drift toward you anyway.

lines.zh: 我很久没吃过新鲜的东西了。
lines.en: It has been long since I ate anything fresh.

lines.zh: 你手上那点味道，隔水也清楚。
lines.en: The scent on your hands is clear even through water.

lines.zh: 我往下压了一点，水面凹下去。
lines.en: I press down and the surface dips.

lines.zh: 我围着你的船转，船跟着晃。
lines.en: I circle your boat, and it rocks along.

lines.zh: 我这把年纪，偏被甜味拽过去。
lines.en: At my age, and still dragged over by sweetness.

lines.zh: 你要是多扔一些，我会靠近些。
lines.en: Throw more and I will come nearer.

lines.zh: 这点诱惑对我这年纪不算什么。
lines.en: At my age, this much temptation means little.

lines.zh: 可我还是张开了伞，很没面子。
lines.en: Yet I still open my bell, which is undignified.

lines.zh: 你撞在我身上，像撞上一堵墙。
lines.en: You strike me as if against a wall.

lines.zh: 我的身体一凹，海水轰地散开。
lines.en: My body dents and the sea bursts outward.

lines.zh: 我没动，是你被弹开了。
lines.en: I did not move; you were the one thrown back.

lines.zh: 我这么大，撞一下不会碎。
lines.en: Being this large, one impact will not break me.

lines.zh: 你的船擦过伞缘，木头发响。
lines.en: Your boat scrapes my rim, and the wood creaks.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地转过来看是谁。
lines.en: I turn slowly to see who it was.

lines.zh: 这一下让你明白我们差多少。
lines.en: That showed you the difference between us.

lines.zh: 我体内的气只是沉了一下。
lines.en: The gas inside me only settles a little.

lines.zh: 你要贴近，就先想清楚。
lines.en: If you come close, think it through first.

lines.zh: 我不生气，我只是记住了。
lines.en: I am not angry; I simply remember.

lines.zh: 我们两个都很大，靠得很慢。
lines.en: We are both huge, and we close in slowly.

lines.zh: 它的伞盖比我的还宽一圈。
lines.en: Its bell is a full ring wider than mine.

lines.zh: 我们并排悬着，海流绕开我们。
lines.en: We hang side by side, and the current flows around us.

lines.zh: 它一开一合，我跟着同样节拍。
lines.en: It pulses, and I follow the same beat.

lines.zh: 我们一起升到那片暖水，很慢。
lines.en: We rise to that warm water together, very slowly.

lines.zh: 我们的光在水里交叠成一片。
lines.en: Our lights overlap into a single glow.

lines.zh: 这么多年，这样的相遇不多。
lines.en: In all these years, meetings like this are rare.

lines.zh: 它不说话，我也不说。
lines.en: It says nothing, and neither do I.

lines.zh: 分开时我们都很慢，谁也没催。
lines.en: We part slowly, and neither hurries the other.

lines.zh: 之后我还会往那个方向漂。
lines.en: Afterward I will drift in that direction still.

lines.zh: 你丢的东西落在我背上，滑下去。
lines.en: What you drop lands on my back and slides off.

lines.zh: 我这么大，也没法把它捡起来。
lines.en: Even this large, I cannot pick it up.

lines.zh: 我的触须太粗，抓不住小东西。
lines.en: My tentacles are too thick to grip small things.

lines.zh: 那块凝胶值钱，可我带不走。
lines.en: That gel is precious, and I cannot carry it.

lines.zh: 你捡吧，我看着你捡。
lines.en: Take it; I will watch you take it.

lines.zh: 它沉到底，惊起一片沙。
lines.en: It sinks to the bottom and stirs up sand.

lines.zh: 我试过卷起一块木板，断了。
lines.en: I once curled around a plank, and it snapped.

lines.zh: 我身上掉下的东西，随水走了。
lines.en: What falls off me goes with the water.

lines.zh: 你手小，正好做这些事。
lines.en: Your hands are small, which suits such work.

lines.zh: 我什么也不捡，什么也不留。
lines.en: I pick nothing up and keep nothing.

lines.zh: 你进入我这片水域，水变紧了。
lines.en: You enter my stretch of water, and it tightens.

lines.zh: 我很久没有认真看过一个目标。
lines.en: It has been long since I truly fixed on a target.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转向你，转了整整半圈。
lines.en: I turn toward you, a full half revolution.

lines.zh: 你的划水声传得很远，我听见了。
lines.en: Your paddling carries far, and I hear it.

lines.zh: 我知道你的位置，你也知道我知道。
lines.en: I know where you are, and you know I know.

lines.zh: 我体内的气往上聚，慢慢来。
lines.en: The gas inside gathers upward, slowly.

lines.zh: 这片深水归我，规则很简单。
lines.en: This deep water is mine, and the rule is simple.

lines.zh: 我不追，我等你游过来。
lines.en: I do not chase; I wait for you to swim in.

lines.zh: 你身上的金属让我很不舒服。
lines.en: The metal on you unsettles me greatly.

lines.zh: 我动了动触须，那就是警告。
lines.en: I stir my tentacles; that is your warning.

lines.zh: 我沉到你下面，挡住你的路。
lines.en: I descend beneath you and block the way.

lines.zh: 我悬在你上方，光被你挡住了。
lines.en: I hang above you, and my light is blocked.

lines.zh: 我不着急，我比你耗得起。
lines.en: I am not rushed; I can outlast you.

lines.zh: 我的触须在水里排成一道帘。
lines.en: My tentacles spread into a curtain in the water.

lines.zh: 你往哪边游，我就往哪边挪。
lines.en: Wherever you swim, I shift that way.

lines.zh: 你听见的闷响，是我在靠近。
lines.en: That low sound you hear is me closing in.

lines.zh: 我算好了距离，很远也很准。
lines.en: I have the distance worked out, far but exact.

lines.zh: 你回头看的时候，我已经不动。
lines.en: When you look back, I am already still.

lines.zh: 我体内越来越紧，快了。
lines.en: The tension inside me builds, and soon.

lines.zh: 我给你留了条路，通向更深处。
lines.en: I leave you one way out, and it leads deeper.

lines.zh: 我的触须扫下来，水被劈成两半。
lines.en: My tentacle sweeps down and splits the water.

lines.zh: 这一下很慢，可你躲不开。
lines.en: The blow is slow, and still you cannot dodge it.

lines.zh: 我压下去，你就动不了了。
lines.en: I press down and you cannot move.

lines.zh: 我撞在你船上，木板裂了。
lines.en: I strike your boat and the planks split.

lines.zh: 我的毒很慢，会跟着你很久。
lines.en: My poison is slow and will follow you a long while.

lines.zh: 我只打了一下，一下就够了。
lines.en: I strike once, and once is enough.

lines.zh: 我退开，是给你留个教训。
lines.en: I withdraw to leave you a lesson.

lines.zh: 你打到我了，我几乎没感觉。
lines.en: You hit me, and I barely felt it.

lines.zh: 我开始发热，这片水都变温了。
lines.en: I begin to heat, and this water warms with me.

lines.zh: 这是最后一下了，我数着呢。
lines.en: This is the last one; I am counting.

lines.zh: 我从最深的地方升上来，用了很久。
lines.en: I rise from the deepest place; it took a long time.

lines.zh: 我成形时，海床震了一下。
lines.en: When I took shape, the seabed shuddered.

lines.zh: 我落在这片深沟上方，停下了。
lines.en: I settle above this trench and go no further.

lines.zh: 我一张开伞盖，周围的水都后退。
lines.en: My bell opens and the surrounding water retreats.

lines.zh: 这一带没有比我更大的东西。
lines.en: Nothing in this stretch is bigger than I am.

lines.zh: 我带着很多气出生，压得很沉。
lines.en: I was born with much gas, and it weighs me low.

lines.zh: 我慢慢习惯这里的压力，用了几天。
lines.en: Getting used to the pressure took me days.

lines.zh: 我第一次亮起来，整片水都白了。
lines.en: The first time I lit, the whole water went white.

lines.zh: 我知道自己会炸，只不知何时。
lines.en: I know I will burst; only the hour is unknown.

lines.zh: 这片海以后会记得我这一下。
lines.en: This sea will remember the day I go off.

lines.zh: 火焰烧在我身上，像不肯灭的光。
lines.en: Fire on me clings like a small stubborn light.

lines.zh: 我从高处坠下，海床被砸出一个坑。
lines.en: I fall from above and crater the seabed.

lines.zh: 我在水里活了一辈子，此刻像溺水。
lines.en: I have lived in water all my life, and now I feel drowned.

lines.zh: 别的爆炸点着我的气，我亮了一瞬。
lines.en: Another blast ignites my gas, and I flare for an instant.

lines.zh: 那支箭太小，我几乎没找到它。
lines.en: The arrow is so small I can hardly find it.

lines.zh: 魔法让我的伞盖抽动，很不舒服。
lines.en: Magic makes my bell twitch, and I dislike it.

lines.zh: 我饿着也不瘦，只是更沉。
lines.en: Hunger does not thin me; it only makes me heavier.

lines.zh: 雷顺着水面打下来，我全身亮了。
lines.en: Lightning comes down the surface and my whole body lights.

lines.zh: 虚空里我飘着，比水轻也比水冷。
lines.en: In the void I float lighter than water and colder.
